password: string } type AuthGlassProps = { onSubmit?: (values: Credentials) => Promise | void onProvider?: (provider: Provider) => void /** what the glass sits on; defaults to layered dusk waves */ background?: React.ReactNode className?: string } // back to front: each wave is lit along its crest and darker below const waves = [ "M0 330C260 270 470 280 720 330S1190 420 1440 320V900H0Z", "M0 450C300 380 560 400 820 460S1250 530 1440 430V900H0Z", "M0 560C250 500 590 590 900 545S1290 480 1440 540V900H0Z", "M0 670C320 630 650 700 960 655S1320 610 1440 660V900H0Z", "M0 790C360 745 760 800 1100 765S1390 755 1440 775V900H0Z", ] function Waves() { // unique gradient ids, so two scenes on one page don't share them const id = React.useId().replace(/[^\w-]/g, "") return ( ) } const well = "h-11 rounded-[14px] border-foreground/12 bg-foreground/[0.06] shadow-[inset_0_1px_2px_oklch(0_0_0/18%)] focus-within:border-foreground/30 focus-within:ring-foreground/10" const quiet = "inline-flex h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-foreground/12 bg-foreground/[0.06] text-[13px] font-medium shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_oklch(1_0_0/18%)] transition-[background-color,scale] duration-150 ease-out outline-none hover:bg-foreground/[0.1] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-foreground/40 active:scale-[0.98] [&_svg]:size-4" // a pane of clear glass over dusk waves; its curved rim bends the crests behind it export function AuthGlass({ onSubmit, onProvider, background, className }: AuthGlassProps) { const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion() const { status, error, run } = useSubmit(onSubmit) const [errors, setErrors] = React.useState<{ email?: string; password?: string }>({}) function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent) { event.preventDefault() const data = new FormData(event.currentTarget) const email = String(data.get("email") ??
